items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: so was Teddy Wilson and a trumpet player, a white trumpet player named, Bunny Berigan in.

ctx.x: pockets all the money and doesn't pay anybody. And he's a millionaire and he's a capitalist and all that. Which is all true, but the thing about him is that he's a beautiful musician. He's a swinger and he can play those vibes...wow!....

I heard him on TV in Paris a couple of years ago and it reminded me all of a sudden how great he is, you know. So Lionel was with Benny Goodman, so was Teddy Wilson and a trumpet player, a white trumpet player named, Bunny Berigan in. A very exciting trumpet player.
He made that one big record.
